subject.title: fix(session-memory): forward hook config model to LLM slug generator

question: Should OpenClaw accept `hooks.internal.entries.session-memory.model` as the supported hook-level config contract for LLM slug generation?
rationale: The code path is narrow and reuses the embedded runner resolver, but it turns a previously undocumented passthrough key into user-visible provider/model routing behavior.

options.title: Accept hook model contract
options.body: Treat `session-memory.model` as intentional supported config and land this PR once normal checks are green.

options.title: Require clearer upgrade docs first
options.body: Ask for public docs or release-note context before merge so existing-config behavior changes are explicit.

options.title: Pause this direction
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers do not want a hook-level model setting to become the slug-routing API.

recommendation.title: Accept hook model contract
recommendation.body: Treat `session-memory.model` as intentional supported config and land this PR once normal checks are green.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the most recent current-main ownership signal on the touched session-memory and slug-generator files and is already the clearest routing owner for this config-contract decision.
